'''Cave lobsters''' are a type of aquatic [[vermin]] found only in [[caverns|underground bodies of water]]. Cave lobsters cannot actually be caught by [[fishing]], and due to a bug they cannot be caught in baited [[animal trap]]s either. If you somehow obtain a raw cave lobster, [[fish cleaning|processing]] it will yield an [[food|edible cave lobster]] and a [[shell]] that cannot be used to craft items, unlike other shells.

Some [[dwarves]] [[Preferences|like]] cave lobsters for their ''beauty''.
